embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis
fields.value: Google DeepMind; the page carries no per-author superscripts, so the exact author(s) tied to Google DeepMind cannot be isolated from the page itself. — FL4N is presented as the first feed-forward latent model for 4D novel view synthesis (NVS), rendering dynamic scenes across new viewpoints and timestamps from monocular video without explicit 4D Gaussian primitives.

fields.name: DriveUniTok: A Unified Multimodal Tokenizer for Driving World-Action Models
fields.value: Xiaomi EV; not on the default illustrative company list, but matches the "automaker AI labs" borderline category named in the brief). — DriveUniTok is a unified multimodal tokenizer for driving world-action models (WAMs) that encodes appearance, projected-LiDAR metric geometry, and ego motion into a single decodable continuous latent, rather than modeling them separately.

fields.name: TurboWAM: Learning What Matters for Fast World Action Models
fields.value: Huawei; footnote states the work was done during an internship at Huawei Canada). FLAG: borderline (Huawei is explicitly named as a borderline example in the task brief). — TurboWAM is a fast world action model (WAM) for robot policy learning that reduces inference latency by adaptively aggregating world-model-layer representations according to their relevance to action prediction, rather than using every layer uniformly.

fields.name: CompMVR: Compression-Aware Multi-View Restoration Using Diffusion Models for Geometrically Consistent 3D Reconstruction
fields.value: Adobe; corresponding author). Remaining authors are affiliated with Kyungpook National University, Republic of Korea. — The paper identifies compression-induced cross-view geometric inconsistency as a failure mode in multi-view 3D reconstruction, where lossy compression disrupts feature matching and correspondence across views.

fields.name: Past as State, Present as Attention: Persistent-State Blockwise Flow Matching for Long-Horizon Co-Speech Motion Generation
fields.value: Alibaba Group; Jia Ma with Tongji University. — The paper tackles long-horizon co-speech motion generation, where existing segment-by-segment methods either drift (short recent-frame conditioning) or become costly and hard to train (ever-growing explicit histories).

fields.name: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
fields.value: Tencent — The paper addresses single-image 3D scene construction, noting that existing end-to-end methods (e.g., SAM-3Dfy) can reconstruct 3D assets and layouts but struggle with fine scene geometry and asset quality.

fields.name: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
fields.value: Xiaomi Inc.; the page does not attach superscripts to individual author names, so the specific Xiaomi-affiliated author(s) cannot be isolated from the HTML. FLAG: borderline (Xiaomi is not on the default illustrative company list but is a large, top-tier consumer tech/AI company (flag) — WorldCast is a framework for world-consistent character video generation under large-angle camera trajectories that combine rotation, translation, and radius change from arbitrary starting azimuths.

fields.name: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
fields.value: Tencent Video — The paper proposes Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), a training method that makes latent representations from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) directly usable to condition video diffusion transformers for cinematic video generation.

fields.name: Gate3DGen: A Pre-processing Model that Selectively Purifies Real-World Images for 3D Generation
fields.value: Huawei Inc. — Gate3DGen is a pre-processing "gate" model for 3D-generation pipelines: clean input images pass through unchanged, while degraded ones are purified by a one-step, 3D-oriented restoration model that preserves object identity and edges.

fields.name: GSHeadRelight: Fast Relightability for 3D Gaussian Head Synthesis
fields.value: Kuaishou Technology — GSHeadRelight addresses relighting and novel-view synthesis of human head portraits — producing photorealistic results in real time, for subjects unseen during training — using generative 3D Gaussians combined with a lighting model based on neural radiance transfer that responds linearly to incident

fields.name: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
fields.value: Hunyuan, Tencent — DRILL is a world-model training framework for reinforcement learning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies, built on the view that world models trained to predict next-frame pixels are misaligned with their real job of producing a useful learning signal for the policy.

fields.name: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
fields.value: Alaya Lab; kept and flagged as a comparable industry lab) — AnyGameRenderer is a video-to-video generative renderer that converts rough game footage — gray blockouts or wireframes — into detailed, game-like visuals while preserving the original layout, camera motion, and entity positions and timing.

fields.name: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
fields.value: Tencent — The paper argues that autoregressive video diffusion models trained with teacher forcing can produce plausible continuations without actually learning how scenes evolve, because strong local visual continuity gives a shortcut for denoising the current chunk.
